# .github Directory

This directory contains repository automation and metadata:

- `workflows/` - GitHub Actions workflow definitions used by this repository.
- `workflow-templates/` - reusable workflow templates for related repositories.
- `actions/` - local composite actions shared across workflows.
- `copilot-instructions.md` - Copilot-specific repository instructions.

Automation configuration details are documented in:

- `docs/development/AUTOMATION_CONFIGURATION.md`
